title: The Way You Stay
subtitle: Easton Echo · Single
excerpt: Easton Echo turns the memory of someone who left into a shimmering late-night pop confession.
body: The Way You Stay is Easton Echo's introduction to the QFR audience—a cinematic synth-pop song about the strange permanence of people who are no longer physically there. Built around shimmering electronics, warm guitars and an increasingly expansive chorus, the song begins quietly and grows into something much larger without losing its intimacy. It is less about missing someone than recognizing how deeply they remain woven into the ordinary details of everyday life.
